source_label: Manage Remote Monitoring Data The system shall allow healthcare providers to add and view remote monitoring data for their patients. Allow healthcare providers to add telemedicine data (such as weight and pedometer readings) for their patients. Provide a list of patients that a healthcare provider is responsible for in terms of remote monitoring. Healthcare providers can successfully add remote monitoring data for their patients. Healthcare providers can view the remote monitoring data for their patients within a specified date range. The system correctly identifies and displays the name of the patient based on their MID. The system allows healthcare providers to manage the list of patients they are responsible for in terms of remote monitoring.
